mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_key FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.perm_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.perm_key IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.perm_name, p.perm_key, p.perm_type, p.parent_id, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.sort, p.status FROM sys_permission p LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.perm_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 AND p.perm_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY p.parent_id, p.sort
